AdminAccount._comment: Tai khoan Admin CAU HINH TAI DAY - dang nhap tai /Account/AdminLogin bang email + mat khau nay (doi truc tiep trong file, restart app la ap dung). Lan dang nhap dau he thong tu tao/gan voi user Admin tuong ung trong DB de cac nghiep vu (dat ho, duyet bao tri, xu ly hoan tien, thong bao...) van day du. Super Account cuu ho van AN hoan toan - chi la SHA-256 hash trong AccountController.
